title: 8J end-of-unit quiz
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y8 lesson 24 (8J end-of-unit quiz (portal quiz))
intro: Covers lessons 9 to 24 of Combustion (8E); light (8J). Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: A gas turns limewater milky. It is…
questions.a: B) Carbon dioxide. Limewater is the test for carbon dioxide. Water is tested with cobalt chloride or copper sulfate.

questions.q: What forms when copper is heated in air?
questions.a: B) Copper oxide. Copper + oxygen → copper oxide. Heating in air supplies oxygen.

questions.q: A TV catches fire. What is safest?
options: Turn off the power at the wall if safe, use a CO₂ extinguisher, get out and call 999
questions.a: B) Turn off the power at the wall if safe, use a CO₂ extinguisher, get out and call 999. Water conducts electricity. Cutting power removes heat source; CO₂ removes oxygen. Safety first: get out and call 999.

questions.q: Which product shows incomplete combustion?
questions.a: C) Carbon monoxide. Carbon monoxide (and soot) form when oxygen is limited. Water forms in both.

questions.q: Which gas is the main cause of acid rain?
questions.a: B) Sulfur dioxide. Sulfur dioxide dissolves in rain to form acids. Nitrogen gas itself is unreactive.

questions.q: How do greenhouse gases warm the Earth?
options: They absorb heat given off by the Earth and re-radiate it
They make holes in the ozone layer
questions.a: B) They absorb heat given off by the Earth and re-radiate it. Greenhouse gases absorb infrared from Earth's surface and send some back. C is a different problem.

questions.q: A Bunsen burner has a yellow flame and blackens a beaker. Why?
questions.a: B) Incomplete combustion: too little oxygen. Yellow flame and soot show incomplete combustion. Opening the air hole adds oxygen.

questions.q: The cold glass above the candle mists up. This shows...
questions.a: B) water is made. Water vapour from combustion condenses on the cold glass.

questions.q: Why close doors when escaping a fire?
options: To limit oxygen and slow the spread
To keep smoke in your room
questions.a: B) To limit oxygen and slow the spread. A closed door limits oxygen and slows the fire and smoke.

questions.q: You see a book because...
options: light reflects off it into your eyes
your eyes send rays to it
questions.a: B) light reflects off it into your eyes. The book is non-luminous; light reflects from it into our eyes.

questions.q: Angle of incidence is 50°. Angle of reflection?
questions.a: B) 50°. The law of reflection: i = r.

questions.q: Which change would most improve accuracy?
options: A thinner beam and sharp pencil
questions.a: B) A thinner beam and sharp pencil. A thin beam and fine lines make the ray positions precise.

questions.q: Light goes from air into water. It...
options: speeds up, bends away from normal
questions.a: B) slows, bends towards normal. Water is denser optically: light slows and bends towards the normal.

questions.q: Which part detects light?
questions.a: C) Retina. The retina has light-sensitive cells.

questions.q: Diffuse reflection happens on...
questions.a: B) rough paper. Rough surfaces scatter light in many directions.

questions.q: Particles in a gas are...
questions.a: Far apart, moving fast

questions.q: The products of complete combustion of a hydrocarbon are...
questions.a: Carbon dioxide and water

questions.q: Products of complete combustion of methane?
questions.a: Carbon dioxide and water

questions.q: Oxidation means...
questions.a: Gaining oxygen

questions.q: What does the flame going out under a jar show?
questions.a: Oxygen has been used up
